5.2.2 Specific Heat

Determining the critical temperature in simulated annealing requires identifying the phase transition point during optimization, which is characterized by peaks in specific heat (Kirkpatrick et al., 1983; Strobl & Barker, 2016). In statistical physics, the system's energy at temperature T, denoted as E(T), adheres to the Boltzmann distribution.
